fields.title: Bluesky record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope on top of Bluesky's own AT Protocol XRPC shapes. Every record carries _input / _source / _scrapedAt / recordType (and _error / _errorDetail on failures). Upstream field names are preserved verbatim, so a post record is an app.bsky.feed.defs#postView, a profile record is an app.bsky.actor.defs#profileViewDetailed, and so on -- consult the AT Protocol lexicons for the full nested shape. Use recordType to split the run's mixed output into tables.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact account, post URL, query or feed URL that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: S1-xrpc for the public AppView (public.api.bsky.app), S2-xrpc-search for the separate search host (api.bsky.app), none on failure.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was emitted.

recordType.title: Record type
recordType.description: PROFILE, POST, REPLY, QUOTE, LIKE, FOLLOWER, FOLLOWING, REPOSTED_BY, LIST, STARTER_PACK, FEED_GENERATOR, TREND, or ERROR.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failure rows: not_found, auth_required, rate_limited, invalid_request, bad_input_or_shape, or exception.

uri.title: AT URI
uri.description: at:// identifier of the post, list, starter pack or feed generator.

cid.title: CID
cid.description: Content hash of the record's current version.

webUrl.title: Web URL
webUrl.description: Added by this actor for convenience -- the human-facing bsky.app permalink for a post record.

did.title: DID
did.description: Decentralised identifier of an account (profile / follower / like actor records).

followersCount.title: Followers
followersCount.description: Profile modes -- follower count at scrape time.

followsCount.title: Following
followsCount.description: Profile modes -- how many accounts this account follows.

author.title: Author
author.description: Post records -- the posting account, nested verbatim.

record.title: Record
record.description: Post records -- the raw app.bsky.feed.post value: text, createdAt, langs, facets (links/mentions/tags), reply refs, embeds.

embed.title: Embed
embed.description: Post records -- hydrated images, video, external link card, or quoted post.

replyCount.title: Replies
replyCount.description: Post records -- reply count at scrape time.

repostCount.title: Reposts
repostCount.description: Post records -- repost count at scrape time.

likeCount.title: Likes
likeCount.description: Post records -- like count at scrape time.

quoteCount.title: Quotes
quoteCount.description: Post records -- quote count at scrape time.

indexedAt.title: Indexed at
indexedAt.description: When the AppView indexed this record.

replyDepth.title: Reply depth
replyDepth.description: REPLY records only -- how many levels below the root post this reply sits, so the flat rows can be rebuilt into a tree.

feedReason.title: Feed reason
feedReason.description: POST records from a feed -- why the item appeared, e.g. a repost wrapper naming the reposting account.

feedReplyContext.title: Feed reply context
feedReplyContext.description: POST records from a feed -- the root/parent the post was replying to.

name.title: Name
name.description: LIST / FEED_GENERATOR records -- the list or feed name.

purpose.title: List purpose
purpose.description: LIST records -- curatelist, modlist, or referencelist.

listItemCount.title: List size
listItemCount.description: LIST records -- how many accounts the list holds.

creator.title: Creator
creator.description: LIST / STARTER_PACK / FEED_GENERATOR records -- the account that made it.

likeCountFeed.title: Feed likes
likeCountFeed.description: FEED_GENERATOR records -- how many accounts liked this custom feed.

topic.title: Trend topic
topic.description: TREND records -- the trend's topic slug.

postCount.title: Trend post count
postCount.description: TREND records -- how many posts drove the trend.

category.title: Trend category
category.description: TREND records -- e.g. politics, sports, pop-culture.

startedAt.title: Trend started at
startedAt.description: TREND records -- when the trend began.

actors.title: Trend actors
actors.description: TREND records -- sample accounts driving the trend.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across every record type this actor emits.

posts.title: Posts
posts.description: Post-shaped records only, with engagement counts.
